receipts.statement: 114 human link clicks on jov.ie/tim in 90 days
receipts.reproducingQuery: select count(*) from click_events ce join creator_profiles cp on cp.id = ce.creator_profile_id where cp.username_normalized = 'tim' and ce.is_bot = false and ce.created_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
receipts.population: jov.ie/tim, is_bot=false, 90 days ending measuredAt; includes founder and team traffic

receipts.statement: 2 people subscribed to updates on jov.ie/tim
receipts.reproducingQuery: select count(*) from notification_subscriptions ns join creator_profiles cp on cp.id = ns.creator_profile_id where cp.username_normalized = 'tim' and ns.unsubscribed_at is null
select count(*) from audience_members am join creator_profiles cp on cp.id = am.creator_profile_id where cp.username_normalized = 'tim' and am.type = 'email'
receipts.population: jov.ie/tim audience members identified by email (anonymous visitors excluded)
